pipelines.name: CI/CD

steps.name: Build test matrix
steps.run:
if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
  git diff --name-only --no-renames HEAD^1 HEAD | python3 .github/scripts/ci_matrix.py >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  python3 .github/scripts/ci_matrix.py --all >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi
cat "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Import each package without httpx
steps.run:
set -eu
check() {
  package=$1
  shift
  echo "::group::$package $*"
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv-$package-$#"
  uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-default-groups --package "$package" "$@"
  uv run --no-sync python -I .github/scripts/import_without_httpx.py "$package"
  echo "::endgroup::"
}
for package in supabase_utils supabase_functions postgrest storage3 supabase_auth realtime supabase; do
  check "$package"
done
check supabase --extra aiohttp

steps.name: Type-check the Python snippets of the Markdown files
Save docker images to cache
steps.run:
mkdir -p /tmp/docker-images
docker ps --all --format '{{.Image}}' | sort -u \
  | xargs docker image save \
  | zstd -T0 > /tmp/docker-images/images.tar.zst

steps.name: Check job results
steps.run:
echo "changes=$CHANGES lint=$LINT imports=$IMPORTS snippets=$SNIPPETS test=$TEST"
[ "$CHANGES" = success ] && [ "$LINT" = success ] && [ "$IMPORTS" = success ] \
  && [ "$SNIPPETS" = success ] \
  && { [ "$TEST" = success ] || [ "$TEST" = skipped ]; }

check-sync.name: Generated sync code is up to date

steps.name: Check for differences
steps.run:
if ! git diff --exit-code; then
  echo "::error::The committed generated sync code is out of date. Run 'make auth.build-sync && make ruff' and commit the result."
  exit 1
fi
